tool.name: eScriptorium
tool.command: export IMPORT_MANIFEST='$input_manifest' && export EXPORT_DIR="\$PWD/exports" && export PROJECT_DIR="\$PWD/projects" && export MODEL_EXPORT_DIR="\$PWD/model-exports" && #if str($export_format) == 'none': export STOP_EXPORT=false && #else: export STOP_EXPORT=true && export STOP_EXPORT_FORMAT='$export_format' && #end if #if $session_archive: export SESSION_ARCHIVE='$session_archive' && #end if exec /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh

configfiles.configfile: #import json #set manifest = {'inputs': [], 'models': []} #if $input: #for $file in $input: #set identifier = $file.element_identifier #set original_name = getattr(identifier, 'unsanitized', identifier) #set ignored = manifest['inputs'].append({'path': str($file), 'name': str(original_name), 'extension': str($file.ext)}) #end for #end if #if $kraken_models: #for $model in $kraken_models: #set identifier = $model.element_identifier #set original_name = getattr(identifier, 'unsanitized', identifier) #set ignored = manifest['models'].append({'path': str($model), 'name': str(original_name), 'extension': str($model.ext)}) #end for #end if #echo json.dumps(manifest)

param.name: input
param.label: Images, PDF, XML or image/XML archive to import
param.help: Original image names are preserved for XML matching. Images load before XML. Leave empty for a new session.

param.name: kraken_models
param.label: Kraken segmentation or recognition models
param.help: The model type is detected automatically. Models appear in the document process panel.

param.name: session_archive
param.label: Resume an eScriptorium session
param.help: Select a session archive produced by this container version. Projects, all transcription layers, annotations, media and model versions are restored. Additional inputs can be imported into the resumed session.

param.name: export_format
param.label: Automatic document exports on exit
param.help: ALTO and PAGE XML export each transcription layer separately; JSON includes all layers. The complete resumable session archive and OCR model files are always saved. Exports created inside the app are collected regardless of this setting.

tool.help:
Launch a single-user eScriptorium session. Input datasets and models are loaded before the entry point opens your document. Import failures are shown in the UI. Leave inputs empty to start with an empty document, or select a previous **resumable session** archive to continue working.
Use **Save results and stop session** when finished. The app finishes existing work, creates the selected document exports, saves OCR model files and verifies a complete database-and-media archive before stopping. If saving fails, the app stays available: retry saving or resume editing from the dialog.
Galaxy collects three outputs: a resumable session archive, document exports, and OCR models. The session archive preserves project structure, transcription history, metadata, annotations and model versions. Restore it with the same container version; PAGE/ALTO archives remain available for other tools.
Choose **Automatic document exports on exit** when launching the tool: ALTO XML (the default), PAGE XML, JSON, or no automatic document exports. This choice does not change the full resumable session archive. Exports created manually inside eScriptorium are also collected.
Periodic checkpoints retain the most recent successful session archive if the container is killed. External job cancellation cannot guarantee a final export or history collection; finish using the app's save-and-stop button.
Administrators must configure this multi-service image to run with ``docker_set_user: "0"`` and forward the public host and HTTPS scheme. See the repository's ``galaxy/job_conf.yml.sample`` and deployment documentation.
